decisions.reason: The source Event is scoped to iOS and does not establish that Android tutorial assets were replaced.
Replacing the iOS tutorial images with a YouTube video makes the current image-based tutorial localization strategy obsolete.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Tutorial images were replaced by the youtube video in the latest version.

decisions.reason: The iOS-specific source Event does not establish any change to Android tutorial localization.
A same-message MODIFY already records the iOS YouTube-video format and removes the obsolete tutorial image strategy.
Replacing tutorial images with a video does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The media replacement does not alter the iOS framework, deprecated-API, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial media change does not alter the requirement to supply an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial media change has no necessary effect on iOS signing configuration.
The iOS tutorial media replacement does not change Android platform modernization requirements.
The source decision does not affect Android permission policy or identified permissions.
Tutorial image replacement is distinct from cleanup of application skin graphics.
Replacing tutorial images with a video does not necessarily change the iPad layout cleanup requirement.
